title: Fixed Rules still opens with Settings — Parts alone
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Settings — Parts' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Settings › Pricing opens on the Fixed Rules tab with its fixed rules.
  • The Tiers and Matrices tabs are hidden.
